scope: Completed first website enrichment goals after private PDF export: discovery, all twenty chapter banks and skill extensions, A2 conversations, daily continuity and local combined-source citations.

implementation.discovery: Find/Cerca searches bilingual topics, vocabulary terms, programmes and source pages; query/filter URLs survive opening, Back and reload. Opened tasks and vocabulary banks receive focus.
implementation.dailyContinuity: Started sessions retain the original vocabulary bank and duration; new chapter sessions use their chapter cards. Daily A2 extras select their scene. Grammar continuation prefers eligible unfinished active-programme units.
implementation.pdfConnections: Six frozen SHA-verified export identities map registered source PDFs to physical pages. Combined student Book 2 uses offset240. One bundle URL can serve multiple sources; releasing one source preserves other connections.
implementation.assessment: Existing credit/first-attempt rules remain. Optional gist/retell state is saved without extra XP/minutes; retelling is self-assessed. Conversation repair preserves the first mistake.

defectsFixed: Formal grammar terms such as imperfetto were absent from search metadata.
Returning from grammar and source-page results reset query/filter context; selected source tasks could remain below the phone viewport.
Book chapters previously reused generic vocabulary banks and the A2 extension lacked chapter conversations.

Personal-practice time reservation could generate unsupported duration25; Today and direct session entry could disagree. A shared supported-layout duration and shared plan now prevent invalid saved progress.

verification.browserIsolation: Disposable owned Chromium and synthetic learner state; no shared book session, real learner records, databases or backups accessed.
verification.visualReview: Reviewed phone discovery, focused source companion, selected vocabulary cards, gist/retell and A2 conversation screenshots; automated responsive checks cover EN/IT320/390/1440.
verification.independentReview: All160 new term/example pairs,20 skill packs and30 A2 turns reviewed; three wording refinements applied. Independent integration review found the duration regression, then verified all924 fixed combinations.

privacy.scope: Only supplied private study roots and static daily output checked; no credential/browser-state or learner database access.

preservation: Original18 banks/144 word IDs,36 core enrichments and8 scenes retain their recorded hashes. Existing mission/unit/source/programme IDs and version-one backup format remain valid. No progress reset or deployment performed.
limitations: Plus2 advertises264 pages; its accessible native sections contain263. Plus1 retains23 unavailable observed source-media assets. No source gaps are fabricated.
The complete private export is an archive of accessible sources, not an exhaustive teaching review or a human completion of the80-day journey.
Browser workflows use desktop Chromium emulation; physical devices, Safari/Firefox and assistive-technology certification are outside this pass.
Device speech and optional external players depend on the learner device/service; pronunciation quality is not assessed.
The app still imports its large catalogues in one client bundle (about492KB gzipped JavaScript); deferred loading needs a separate data/planning refactor and cold-load benchmark.
